narration: You use your debit card daily thinking it's the responsible choice. But if someone drains your account tonight, you might not get a dollar back.
visual: Debit card SVG centered on dark background with pulsing red warning triangle badge top-right. 'WAIT.' in red text above, 'YOUR DEBIT CARD HAS A DANGEROUS SECRET' in white. Hook text animates in below: 'IF SOMEONE DRAINS YOUR ACCOUNT TONIGHT... YOU MIGHT GET NOTHING BACK' in red.

narration: Credit cards give you something debit doesn't — federal law limits your fraud liability to fifty dollars, and most cards make it zero.
visual: Credit card SVG on light background with green shield-and-checkmark badge springing in from top right. '$50' counts up to full amount in large green text. 'MAX LIABILITY' and 'FEDERAL LAW · ZERO ON MOST CARDS' labels below. Card-shaped info box: 'It's not your money yet — so thieves can't take it.'

narration: Debit is different — that's your real cash. Report fraud within two days: fifty-dollar liability. Wait sixty days? Unlimited. Your bank keeps everything — legally.
visual: Piggy bank SVG on dark background that slowly drains in color from orange to grey. Three animated timeline cards reveal one by one: WITHIN 2 DAYS ($50 green border), 2 TO 60 DAYS ($500 amber border), AFTER 60 DAYS (UNLIMITED red border).

narration: Even if you report quickly, your bank has ten full business days to investigate while your money stays frozen. No rent, no groceries — just waiting.
visual: Calendar SVG on light background with 10 day-cells filling red one by one. 'YOUR CASH: FROZEN' badge springs in below calendar once all 10 days are red. Supporting text: 'Can't pay rent. Can't buy groceries. That's your real money — just gone.'

narration: The average unauthorized debit transaction is four thousand nine hundred dollars. Sixty-five percent of Americans use debit as their main card, thinking it's the safer option.
visual: Side-by-side bar chart on dark background. CREDIT bar (small, green) grows first showing $50. DEBIT bar (tall, red) grows to full height showing $4,900. '65% OF AMERICANS USE DEBIT AS THEIR PRIMARY CARD' stat box fades in below.

narration: Here's the fix — and it's completely free. Use a credit card for all purchases and pay it off every month. Full protection, your cash stays safe.
visual: Green credit card SVG springs in with white checkmark badge. Three icons spring in below: green shield (FRAUD PROTECTED), blue graph (BUILD CREDIT), orange piggy bank (CASH STAYS SAFE). 'USE CREDIT. PAY IT OFF.' green CTA button. 'Follow for more money moves →' text.
